scope: MUSITU Financial Fabric application/runtime security qualification on the isolated internal-security branch
claim_boundary: MUSITU internal security analysis only. This is not independent validation, certification, regulatory approval, production authorization, or proof of a deployed target.
trust_boundaries: MUSITU application to identity and authorization services
MUSITU application to PostgreSQL metadata store
MUSITU application to external payment rails
external rail webhooks to MUSITU callback handling
future Kubernetes target to the 26 required runtimes

status_vocabulary.internally_tested: A control has direct internal code/test or CI evidence on this branch. This does not mean independent or production validation.
status_vocabulary.partial: Some internal controls exist but material residual work remains.
status_vocabulary.open_target: Requires a real explicitly authorized deployment target and target-side evidence.
status_vocabulary.open_external: Requires evidence or authorization from an external authority/provider and cannot be self-attested by MUSITU.

threats.threat: Forged, inactive, incorrectly scoped, or wrong-audience bearer identity is accepted.
threats.residual: Real identity-provider deployment and operational key/credential controls remain target-dependent.

threats.threat: An authenticated principal accesses or dispatches a merchant/resource it is not authorized to control.
threats.residual: Production OpenFGA/OPA policy deployment and target decision telemetry remain target-dependent.

threats.threat: Forged, replayed, duplicated, or cross-rail webhook input mutates payment truth.
threats.residual: Real provider callback contract, credential issuance, and endpoint authorization remain external.

threats.threat: Concurrent or repeated requests double-apply monetary or authorization state transitions.
threats.residual: Target-scale contention and failure-injection characterization remain open.

threats.threat: Metadata/payment state diverges from ledger truth or reconciliation silently accepts mismatch.
threats.residual: Production-scale TigerBeetle topology, failover, and target reconciliation evidence remain open.

threats.threat: A production rail is silently enabled, redirected, or operated with an unconfirmed contract/configuration.
threats.residual: Provider-issued credentials, approval, and real endpoint contract remain external and must not be inferred.

threats.threat: Oversized or malformed protocol input, including hostile XML constructs, causes unsafe parsing or state corruption.
threats.residual: Broader property/fuzz coverage is still desirable; this status covers current explicit limits and XML hardening only.

threats.threat: Known-vulnerable or silently drifted Python dependencies enter the qualified runtime.
threats.residual: Internal advisory scanning is not a substitute for external supply-chain attestation or future vulnerability monitoring.

threats.threat: Production secrets are embedded in source, broadly exposed, or reused outside a dedicated secret-delivery boundary.
threats.residual: A dedicated repository-wide secret-scanner evidence artifact and real OpenBao/SPIRE target integration are not yet proven on this branch.

threats.threat: Application compromise gains unnecessary container/root privilege or mutable runtime dependency drift.
threats.residual: Cluster admission enforcement and runtime sandboxing require real target evidence.

threats.threat: A target deployment permits unintended east-west traffic, weak workload identity, overbroad RBAC, or unmeasured workload placement.
threats.residual: No real 26-runtime Kubernetes target has been deployed or target-qualified; static staging cannot close this threat.

threats.threat: Backups are unavailable, unauthentic, or unrestorable after failure while the system incorrectly reports readiness.
threats.residual: CI recovery exercises exist, but target-specific backup, restore, retention, encryption, and disaster-recovery evidence remain open.

threats.threat: MUSITU self-attests provider, bank, regulatory, KYC, or independent-security approval and incorrectly enables live funds.
threats.residual: Required approvals/evidence must come from the applicable external authorities/providers; MUSITU_LIVE_FUNDS_ENABLED remains false.

threats.threat: Privileged or concurrent operations mutate merchant/payment state without durable, reviewable authorization evidence.
threats.residual: Real operator IAM, break-glass procedure, and target audit retention require deployment evidence.

threats.threat: Input volume or dependency latency exhausts resources and causes unsafe degradation.
threats.residual: Realistic load, resource, queue, timeout, and recovery benchmarks have not yet been measured on the intended target.

threats.threat: Production dependencies or rail calls use insecure or unpinned transport endpoints.
threats.residual: Certificate lifecycle, target egress enforcement, and provider-side transport configuration require real environment evidence.
